From the arcade

Sliding Tiles

Eight tiles, one empty square, and a little planning ahead.

Play Sliding Tiles →

How to play

  1. Click a tile immediately beside the empty square. It slides into that space. Diagonal moves are not allowed.
  2. Put the tiles in numerical order from left to right, with the empty square at the bottom right.
  3. Every starting position is made by legal moves from the solved board, so it is always solvable.
  4. New puzzle starts a different scramble and clears the move counter.

Plan ahead: placing a tile correctly can require moving it away again first.
